mistake_reason: At step 11, WebSurfer asserted with certainty that it found and opened a cached mirror of the spreadsheet at a fabricated URL and claimed specific columns and calculated values from that preview. This information was not grounded in any accessible tool output or real data. The agent fabricated a source and precise numbers (e.g., words/day values and a slowest title) and used them to drive the final answer. This matches FM-4.1 (Hallucination): generating factually incorrect details without grounding in tools or data.
